text:
Before the meal: a plate of cheese tortellini in meat/tomato sauce, a bowl of spinach salad, and a small cup of dressing.

Tortellini portion: about 25 pieces, roughly 250 g with sauce. At about 1.7 kcal/g that is about 425 kcal.

Salad: about 60 g of spinach with a few other vegetables, around 20 kcal.

Dressing: about 30 g of vinaigrette, around 100 kcal if all of it was used. The cup appears empty afterward, so I assume it was eaten.

After the meal: the plate has only sauce residue left, so I count about 95% of the tortellini as eaten, about 235 g and 400 kcal. The salad bowl is nearly empty, so about 58 g and 20 kcal. The dressing cup is empty, so about 25 g and 90 kcal.

Total: about 400 + 20 + 90 = 510 kcal, and about 235 + 58 + 25 = 318 g of food. This leaves out the water.
